equity.level_reason: Age defines the population and the recommendation groups (60–74, ≥75 years) without social-position framing; rurality appears only in the recommendation's risk-factor list as an access issue, which is a descriptor.

notes: All headline quantities (manufacturer efficacy from hazard ratios, observational VE, FDA self-controlled case series IRRs, VSD rapid cycle analysis, Monte Carlo benefit-risk model) are cited from trials, studies and ACIP presentations, so they are not the article's own procedures. The pooled relative risks across trials may be Work Group GRADE computations, which would argue for data_focus yes. Data sources (RCTs, VISION, IVY, VHA, Medicare, VSD, RSV-NET, BRFSS) are cited evidence, not analyzed here.
